Name: (CF) Cerri's entertainment stand (CES)
Author: CerridwynMorgana
Description:
Requires [CP] Cerri's working televisions CES to complete.

Replaces vanilla game televisions with televisions that coordinate with other Cerri's mods .

Adds an entertainment stand with various decorations, a plant and a decorative surround sound system.
